captures: How long ago the memory formed. Ordinary chatter fades from retrieval while nothing is ever deleted from the store.
How strongly the moment was felt, on the arousal-modulated consolidation finding that emotional events are remembered better than neutral ones.
Whether the memory is a promise, gift, or betrayal, gated by how far the NPC trusts the speaker, so plot beats outrank small talk.
Whether the memory is about what was just said, mixing lexical overlap with embedding similarity so neither rare wording nor paraphrase is missed.
Whether the memory's affect matches the NPC's current mood, the mood-congruent recall effect. This is the term RQ1 measures.
